name: Free PDF to Flipbook
author: onodev77

sections.description:
Free PDF to Flipbook is a lightweight and easy-to-use WordPress plugin that converts PDF documents into interactive, realistic flipbooks. Perfect for brochures, magazines, catalogs, eBooks, and more, this plugin enhances user experience by providing a smooth and engaging 3D flipbook effect, along with a PDF viewer and seamless PDF embed functionality.

Features:
– Convert PDFs into flipbooks easily
– Supports high-quality rendering
– Zoom, drag, and navigate through pages
– Fully responsive and mobile-friendly
– Compatible with any WordPress theme
– Uses shortcode to embed flipbooks anywhere

Plugin Sources

This plugin uses the following external libraries:

  1. PDF.js (by Mozilla) – License: Apache 2.0

    • Source: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
    • Included files: js/pdf.js, js/pdf.worker.js

  2. Turn.js – License: GPL

    • Source: https://www.turnjs.com/
    • Included file: js/turn.min.js

All external libraries are used in accordance with their licenses.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the fptf-flipbook-converter.zip file via WordPress Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin via the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the PDF TO FLIPBOOK menu in your WordPress dashboard.
  4. Upload a PDF file and generate the flipbook.
  5. Copy the generated [fptf-flipbook pdf="URL"] shortcode and paste it into your page or post.
sections.faq:
How do I add a flipbook to my post or page?

After uploading a PDF, the plugin generates a shortcode like [fptf-flipbook pdf="URL"]. Copy and paste this into your post or page.

Does this plugin support mobile devices?

Yes! The flipbooks are fully responsive and work across all screen sizes.

Can I customize the flipbook?

Yes, you can adjust the flipbook appearance with CSS and modify settings via the plugin.

Does the plugin support high-resolution PDFs?

Yes, PDFs are rendered with high-quality scaling for sharp text and images.
